tasks.description: 1. Read attached v2 and shared solution; preserve source identity and limitations.
2. Create property, assumption, coverage and variant contracts before modeling.
3. Validate toolchain: true/false safety and fair/unfair temporal smoke models.
4. Implement core, deterministic witnesses, simulation, Apalache and TLC checks.
5. Kill at least eight isolated protocol mutants; preserve and replay traces.
6. Execute required topology, reservation and compact mechanism variants.
7. Execute operational recovery, membership, intervention and trust perturbations.
8. Execute observer access, disclosure, relational privacy and leak controls.
9. Execute asynchronous/eventual/bounded timing, queue/capacity and negative controls.
10. Execute small integrated/privacy-time and multilateral configurations; audit mappings.
11. Reconcile literal coverage, conformance obligations, findings and final reports.
12. Complete relevant workflow/spec checks and publish local reproducible evidence.

instruction:
Read context files, work through pending tasks, mark complete as you go.
Pause if you hit blockers or need clarification.
context: Follow applicable project instructions and .agents/workflow-project.json. Shared procedures come from the pinned .agents/workflow; project commands and authority remain local.
operationGuidance: Follow .agents/workflow/docs/project-flow.md. Continue through useful authorized implementation, inspection, repair and affected revalidation without asking whether to continue.

Replan within the same intent as evidence changes. Update specs/design/tasks coherently; a materially different intent or independently deliverable scope needs a separate change proposal, not silent scope growth.

First complete independent authorized work before asking for a missing material decision or permission. Record exact blockers and unblock actions; do not turn a checkpoint or debugging result into task completion.
Recheck the affected specification and validation contract before semantic implementation; revise artifacts within scope when evidence changes.

Qualify decisive feedback and retain material failure/replay evidence using .agents/workflow/skills/verification-design/SKILL.md. Verify the whole requested outcome before no-change completion; a partial fix or passing retry is insufficient.

Review actual code and evidence using .agents/workflow/skills/verification-design/SKILL.md. Repair material in-scope findings and revalidate affected results; a review stage is not a handoff or task completion. Do not claim independent review for self-review.

Reconcile required properties and selected test sets with actual executed cases/families, skips, configurations and gaps using .agents/workflow/skills/verification-design/SKILL.md. Manifest validity is not execution or oracle evidence.

Query and run the verification.json closure for every affected requirement, property, owner or source path in the increment. Confirm each expected exact test identity executed and passed; preserve failures and gaps.

After each edit run only the smallest directly invalidated cases, then expand to dependent or sibling cases when required. Reuse green evidence until a declared invalidation dependency changes, and run the complete iteration case set once at the stable iteration boundary.

Validate discovery.json for the affected property/test selection before accepting explore/check scope decisions. Unavailable semantic or IDE search is recorded with its exact reason, never silently substituted.

Execute relevant existing commands through .agents/workflow/docs/project-flow.md; users need not invoke Make separately. Select the documented workflow, specification and readiness checks plus required behavioral evidence. Missing checks are not passes.
Use relevant domain skills and risk-based local checks. Read-only audit stopping applies only to audit scope; it does not limit an authorized implementation workflow.

DONE includes verified no-change completion and requires the requested outcome, matching artifacts, a passing complete verification.json run --all --require-clean on the final relevant code, diff/behavior inspection and resolved material findings. Report limitations and separate local completion from external approval/deployment.
